subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity score on oldText match failure

question: Which oldText mismatch diagnostic format should become canonical for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97032 before any candidate PR merges?
rationale: Automation can verify boundedness and CI, but the open candidates expose different user-facing formats and the linked issue requests richer diff/whitespace/escape diagnostics than this branch currently provides.

options.title: Prefer richer bounded diagnostics
options.body: Choose or adapt an implementation that keeps candidate search bounded while showing visible diff, indentation, and escaping hints that match the linked issue more closely.

options.title: Accept similarity-only hints
options.body: After current-head proof, intentionally land this simpler similarity-score format and ask sibling PRs to rebase or close against that contract.

options.title: Defer the diagnostic feature
options.body: Keep the issue open and pause candidate PRs if maintainers decide the extra diagnostic surface should not be standardized now.

recommendation.title: Prefer richer bounded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Choose or adapt an implementation that keeps candidate search bounded while showing visible diff, indentation, and escaping hints that match the linked issue more closely.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent `edit-diff.ts` refactor history makes this the best available owner signal for the diagnostic contract choice.
